3.0
RACI & Authority Matrix
Each task’s responsibility assignment and its approval limits, combined into one table.
PROCESS STEP	AP CLERK	FINANCE MANAGER	PROCUREMENT LEAD	CONTROLLER	AUTHORITY RULES
Create Purchase Order	R	A	C
More than $10,000 needs approval from AP Clerk.
More than 2 days without a decision escalates to Procurement Lead.
Approve Purchase Order	I	A	C
At or above $100,000 needs approval from Finance Manager.
More than $50,000 needs approval from Controller.
More than 3 days without a decision escalates to Controller.
Revise Purchase Order
No approval required — this step proceeds on its own.
More than 3 days without a decision escalates, but nobody is assigned.
Send PO to Vendor					No authority rules.
Match Invoice to PO	R	A		C
More than $20,000 needs approval from Finance Manager.
More than 2 days without a decision escalates, but nobody is assigned.
Approve Payment	I	A		R
More than $100,000 needs approval from Controller.
More than $50,000 needs approval.
More than 5 days without a decision escalates to Finance Manager.
Pay Vendor	R	A		I
More than $100,000 needs approval from Finance Manager.
More than 1 day without a decision escalates to Controller.
4.0
Governance, Controls & Metrics
Key Control Points
"Approve Purchase Order" above $50,000 requires separate sign-off from Controller in addition to the primary approver.
⚠ "Approve Payment" requires a second sign-off above $50,000, but nobody is assigned to it — this needs to be resolved in the Authority Matrix.
